source: ACIAR / University of New England / CARE, "IPM Field Guide for Soybean Pest Management in Cambodia," ACIAR project field guide, 2006
text:
For farmers who do need to spray, the guide lists specific commercial pesticide products by active ingredient class with brand names, concentrations, and dose rates, organized by target pest/mode of action:

- Bt (Bacillus thuringiensis) products against Heliothis-type caterpillars: brands including Aztron, Biobit 52BFC, Dipel 6.4 DF, Delfin WG, Fowarbit 16.00 IU, Sandoz PH, Thuricide HP — sourced from Vietnam, Thailand, and English-labelled stock, with %-active-ingredient and dose columns per product.
- Alpha-cypermethrin products against Heliothis: Fastocid 5 EC, Fastox 5 EC, Motox 5 EC, Sapan alpha 5 EC, Tilt alpha 5 EC, Vifast 5 ND.
- Cypermethrin products against pod borer/Heliothis: a long list including Andoril 250EC, Carmethrin 25 EC, Chix, Cykker 10, Cyrus 25, Frong 35, Koutnok 10, Luxenpob, Luxentoy 10, Punisx 25EC, Sherpa 25 ND, Siker 10, Starnox 350, Tenzo, Theboss, Tung Rin 10 EC, Uptane, Vekus 10, Vinbin, Visher 25 ND, World Toid 10 EC.
- Deltamethrin products against stink bug (ស្រីងបែតង): Bai 58, Basoca, Bl 58, BiAN 40EC, Bini 58 40EC, Dibathote 40 EC, Dimethoate 40 EC, Famtoy 50, Luxenmet 40, Nugor 40 EC, Vidithoate 40 ND.

The guide devotes a full section to pesticide-use health and safety: symptoms of acute poisoning (dizziness, weakness, headache, tremor, vomiting, poor concentration, watery/itchy eyes) split into physical vs. mental symptom lists; a labeled diagram of full personal protective equipment (hat, mask/respirator, goggles, long sleeves, gloves, boots, apron) with the instruction to wear appropriate PPE matched to label hazard symbols; guidance on decontaminating equipment after spraying; and an explicit warning about spray drift — that aerial or ground spraying can drift onto bystanders, water sources, or neighboring crops depending on wind, and a diagram showing how pesticide residues can leach through soil into groundwater and surface water over time.
